name: DataTable
description: Accessible data table with typed columns, three-state sortable headings, optional row selection and pagination, and density variants. Composes the Table primitives and the useTable* hooks.

ariaRequirements: native table, thead, tbody, th and td semantics
caption supplies the accessible table name
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-26 — native table, caption, sorting, selection labels, keyboard behavior, and axe result reviewed in unit tests. 2026-08-03 — Phase 1 pass: light/dark/forced-colors verified in a real browser; keyboard contract (Tab/Space/Enter) driven by a play story; axe clean across 9 stories x 3 modes; AT-tree and real-browser forced-colors evidence captured.

dense: typed native data table; sortable columns, optional row selection, accessible caption, empty state, sm/md/lg density

pageSize.description: Rows per page; enables pagination when set.

stickyHeader.description: Pin the header row while the body scrolls.

forbiddenUse: use unstable row indexes as identifiers

usage.description: Use DataTable for structured records that users need to compare, sort, or select. Provide stable row identifiers and a meaningful caption.

bestPractices.description: Give every table a concise caption that explains what its rows represent.
Use stable domain identifiers so selection survives sorting and data refreshes.
Make a column sortable only when its values have an understandable order.
Keep cell content concise and move detailed content into a dedicated view.
Do not use DataTable as a page-layout grid or a visual card collection.
Do not hide row actions until pointer hover; keyboard users must find them too.

anatomy.name: Caption
anatomy.description: Accessible name that explains the table's record set.

anatomy.name: Header
anatomy.description: Column labels and optional sort controls.

anatomy.name: Rows
anatomy.description: Typed records rendered as native table rows and cells.

anatomy.name: Selection
anatomy.description: Native checkboxes for selecting individual or all visible rows.
